g.text: Gradio: the latency cost of a persistent process

text.style: font-size: 13px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #566171

g.text: M5 Mac · one worker per endpoint · no autoscaling · lower latency is better

g.text: First process call: 0.72–1.34 s including startup and callback work; excluded from warm medians.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #626975

g.text: Three alternating rounds per case; sequential requests, identical outputs checked. Callback measurements exclude HTTP and preprocessing.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #626975

g.text: Streaming demo retains its 50 ms delay per chunk. HTTP tests cover text/arithmetic only. Small local experiment, not a universal latency guarantee.
